# Honesty — Provenance Discipline

The guardrail that keeps a broad map useful: every claim is tagged computable, empirical, or aspirational. Computable claims are shown with their compute; empirical figures carry a `source` with graded provenance (source_type sets the confidence prior); aspirational targets are named as such and checked against reality. Concrete 2024–2026 examples (KEYNOTE-942 press-release-vs-peer-review, TESLA neoantigen validation rates) ground the discipline in measured failure modes.
